description: This PHP source file defines an event listener class 'EmployeeListener' for the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. The class handles encryption and decryption of employee SSN data during lifecycle events such as pre-update, post-update, and post-load, ensuring sensitive data is encrypted in storage and decrypted when accessed.

classes.name: EmployeeListener
classes.description: A listener class that handles encryption and decryption of Employee SSN data during Doctrine ORM lifecycle events.

methods.name: preUpdate
methods.description: Encrypts the SSN number if it has changed before updating the Employee entity.

methods.name: postUpdate
methods.description: Decrypts the SSN number after the Employee entity has been updated.

methods.name: postLoad
methods.description: Decrypts the SSN number after the Employee entity has been loaded from the database.
